queries: WITH colleges AS (SELECT DISTINCT college FROM major WHERE college IS NOT NULL), college_income AS (SELECT ma.college, SUM(COALESCE(i.amount, 0)) AS total_income_amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major WHERE ma.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.college), overall AS (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS total_income_amount FROM income) SELECT c.college, COALESCE(ci.total_income_amount, 0) AS total_income_amount, 1.0 * COALESCE(ci.total_income_amount, 0) / NULLIF(o.total_income_amount, 0) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM colleges AS c LEFT JOIN college_income AS ci ON ci.college = c.college CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY c.college;

WITH colleges AS (SELECT DISTINCT college FROM major WHERE college IS NOT NULL), college_income AS (SELECT ma.college, SUM(COALESCE(i.amount, 0)) AS total_income_amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major WHERE ma.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.college), attributable_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_income_amount) AS total_income_amount FROM college_income) SELECT c.college, COALESCE(ci.total_income_amount, 0) AS total_income_amount, 1.0 * COALESCE(ci.total_income_amount, 0) / NULLIF(t.total_income_amount, 0) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM colleges AS c LEFT JOIN college_income AS ci ON ci.college = c.college CROSS JOIN attributable_total AS t ORDER BY c.college;

assumptions.assumption: Total income means all income records, including any that cannot be linked to a college. A fraction is NULL when total income is zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Total income means only income that can be linked to a college.
